usage: icebath codex-runtime [-h] {migrate} ...

Noninteractive counterpart of the /codex-runtime slash command. Toggling the runtime itself stays
in the chat command (`/codex-runtime on|off`); `migrate` re-projects Icebath' mcp_servers +
installed codex plugins into the managed block of ~/.codex/config.toml for the selected profile.

positional arguments:
  {migrate}
    migrate   Regenerate the icebath-managed block in codex's config.toml

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
